$comment: Generated from spec/taxonomy.yaml in microsoft/azure-sql-skills-lab. The authoritative list of domains. Slugs are source directory names under skills/ and are stripped on install; number is display order only and has already changed once, so never derive an id from it.

domains.title: Provisioning and local dev
domains.goal: Get a developer to a working database in minutes, and onto the right service tier when the workload is real

domains.title: Drivers and connectivity
domains.goal: Connect from any language first try, and fix it fast when it fails

domains.title: Schema and ORM
domains.goal: Model data and wire up the ORM the developer already uses

domains.title: T-SQL correctness and patterns
domains.goal: Where agents trained on PostgreSQL go wrong on Azure SQL Database

domains.title: Identity and access (Entra ID)
domains.goal: Passwordless by default, and unblock the setup that fails silently

domains.title: Security and safe SQL
domains.goal: Stop the agent writing the vulnerability, and lock the database down by default

domains.title: Schema change and CI/CD
domains.goal: Ship schema changes safely across every migration tool developers actually use

domains.title: Azure patterns and deploy
domains.goal: Take a working local app to Azure the way Microsoft intends

domains.title: APIs and application patterns
domains.goal: Expose and consume the database over HTTP and from serverless, without hand-written plumbing

domains.title: AI, vector and RAG
domains.goal: Build, run and debug AI features directly on SQL, locally and in the cloud

domains.title: Performance and diagnostics
domains.goal: When something is slow, stuck or throttled, give the agent the playbook

domains.title: Operate and recover
domains.goal: For the developer handed a database, using only what Azure SQL actually has

domains.title: Migration to Azure SQL
domains.goal: Move on-premises and hosted SQL Server workloads to Azure SQL Database

domains.title: Data movement
domains.goal: Get data in, out and between databases with the tools that actually exist on this platform

domains.title: Azure SQL Database container
domains.goal: Local-first development against the same engine that runs in the cloud

domains.title: Docs and feedback
domains.goal: Orient the agent, point it at the right documentation, and close the loop from inside the agent that used the skill
